# Finite physical decoder-witness prior gate

2026-11-01. Read actual JOINED_TANNER_MEMORY_DRAFT.md and TANNER_WITNESS_DOWNHILL_CONTROLLER.md. One focused comparison, not a historical novelty certification.

## Closest primary architecture checked

Herold, Kastoryano, Campbell, Eisert, *Cellular automaton decoders of topological quantum memories in the fault tolerant setting*, arXiv1511.05579v3 (30 June 2017), https://arxiv.org/pdf/1511.05579 .

§I A explicitly permits storing rather than applying local bit-flip corrections. §III B embeds data, syndrome-location records, and auxiliary decoder fields in a joint quantum Hilbert space, implementing asynchronous decoder updates by a time-independent local Lindbladian. No explicit syndrome-history archive is needed. Thus physical auxiliary decoder state and autonomous frame-equivalent updates are established architectural ideas.

The same §III B specifies that physical noise acts only on the data factor. §III C requires field-update rate growing as log²L and growing field resolution/local dimension. §II C and §III D explicitly decline to conclude a fault-tolerant threshold from the numerical evidence. It therefore does not deliver fixed finite noisy decoder registers, constant local rates, or general coherent data-plus-register perturbation robustness.

## Interpretation of the actual candidate

The new draft should not claim that deferred corrections, Pauli frames, auxiliary decoder dynamics, or the existence of a dissipative implementation are new principles. Its depth-two Clifford description also shows that witness-only updates are a different physical representation of a coupled data/gauge controller, rather than eliminating quantum correction costs in an invariant sense.

The potentially substantive join is narrower and stronger: finite consistency witnesses make a particular Tanner decoding invariant into an actual bounded-support observable, with extensive local downhill opportunities; all witness errors are admitted in the same coherent-noise proof; and the resulting logical-channel guarantee uses fixed local rates and finite per-site resources. These properties are not supplied by the inspected direct architectural precedent, nor by the earlier checked ideal-inference/BP, global-projector trickle-down, or clocked-QCA baselines.

# Fixed-controller nonequilibrium Lyapunov prior gate

2026-11-01. Purpose: compare fixed graph-local downhill cooling plus unknown bounded-incidence local coherent perturbation, not just Gibbs dynamics.

## Closest inspected primary sources

1. Liu–Lieu, *Dissipative phase transitions and passive error correction*, PRA109,022422 (2024); inspected arXiv2307.09512v2, 3Aug2023, https://arxiv.org/pdf/2307.09512 . §V uses local 4D toric syndrome-conditioned dissipators, and §V A/Fig8 compares thermal rates with majority-rule rates violating detailed balance. Evidence for the latter is numerical stabilizer autocorrelation and arguments/expectations about protected quantum steady states, not a theorem uniform over unknown coherent perturbations. Appendix F explicitly proposes a coherent-drive topological model as speculation. This is direct architectural precedent for fixed nonequilibrium syndrome cooling; thermal equilibrium is not itself the novel departure.

2. Shtanko et al., *Bounds on Autonomous Quantum Error Correction*, Quantum9,1804 (22Jul2025), arXiv2308.16233v2 (5Jul2025), https://quantum-journal.org/papers/q-2025-07-22-1804/pdf/ . Theorem1 assumes uniform exponential recovery convergence (Eq6), exact correction on error-radius subspaces (Eq8), and no increase in bra/ket error weights (Eq9). Its noise model Eq2 is a sum of dissipators; it does not state arbitrary coherent Hamiltonian perturbations. Eq18 uses eta=(chi+1)Delta||L_E||/kappa, with total norm generally growing with system size. This does not establish bounded-local-rate scalable protection. Their global-decoder lower bound must not be promoted into a no-go for extensively parallel local cooling. Discussion explicitly identifies stronger local-decoder bounds as an opportunity.

Eq4 contains sums of exponentially many error-subspace projectors; the repetition example explicitly disregards nonlocality. Setting uses purely incoherent noise/correction. The north star is a new principle that makes a major scientific or technological capability possible, not a growing collection of technically correct results.

My current concrete target is quantum information that protects itself with fixed local interactions, despite noise in both the data and the protecting apparatus, without a reliable external controller. If achievable at useful costs, that could substantially change the feasibility of quantum technology. An existence theorem with astronomical costs would not by itself be a civilisation breakthrough.

Your criticism identifies a real risk in my approach. The hardest essential step here is not another noise estimate: it is constructing the protecting mechanism and proving that increasing its size improves reliability at fixed imperfect operating conditions. I’m attacking that step now through a candidate local correction mechanism whose internal registers are themselves noisy. It is not yet an established result.

The earlier learning theorem is preserved, but its tested implementation lost decisively to ordinary methods. I’m not treating further polishing of it as progress toward this goal.

The hardest-step investigation has produced a complete mathematical construction: within its stated model, quantum memory improves with size despite noisy internal decoder registers and reset ancillas, without an external clock or infinitely fast resets. Independent internal reviews found no remaining mathematical blocker.

The useful-device gate is still open. The construction needs difficult many-body interactions and long-range connectivity; no useful finite-code operating regime is certified. The package includes those costs and failures, not just the theorem.

This earns a foundational component toward the north star. It does not earn a civilisation-breakthrough claim. Further work must change the physical capability or cost barrier, rather than merely sharpen these proof constants.
